entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 serves as a universal memory layer providing multi-level state management for users, sessions, and agents. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud, self-hosted server, or an Apache-2.0 SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This context database organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading architecture. It is designed to reduce token consumption and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging context paths.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across multiple sessions. It builds these graphs from text and code sources while supporting custom data models and ontologies for domain grounding.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph to extract typed entity relationships and provide synthesized answers with citations. It is built for institutional memory, offering scoped data access and explicit gap analysis for missing information.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine featuring a custom vector graph engine that supports automated fact extraction, knowledge updates, and forgetting. It offers sub-300ms recall and integrates with external platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn over time. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and offers client SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents, featuring a FastAPI-based core service logic. It supports session and peer management through Python and TypeScript SDKs, with deployment options ranging from local to managed cloud.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This system manages memory as a git-like repository, utilizing version control operations like commit, branch, and merge for context trees. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that requires only pure Python and a SQLite database for sub-millisecond operations. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and integrates via MCP or native tools.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory-os employs a seven-layer memory architecture that combines vector search on Qdrant with structured facts and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts during recall.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive context harness produces filesystem-first artifacts such as traces and playbooks to help agents succeed on complex tasks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to validate the effectiveness of context changes.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: Hermes-lcm is a lossless context management plugin that uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise detail recovery.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes session history from 24 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over gigabytes of local data. It allows agents to search months of past interactions while redacting sensitive keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for private cross-session memory using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible provider to maintain persistence for Hermes Agent.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer achieves 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy by ingesting real-time data from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub. It functions as a portable state layer across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other MCP clients.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur uses a local-first approach to store shared memory as plain-text YAML files for full user ownership. It employs a hybrid search strategy combining BM25 and embeddings to serve MCP-compatible tools like Cursor and OpenClaw.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and agent hooks, utilizing hybrid BM25 and vector search to manage agent memory.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema with FTS5 search, completely bypassing the need for vector databases or embedding models. The system includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and supports Linux, macOS, and Windows environments.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to save up to 36% in token usage.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It includes a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn turns an Obsidian vault into a cross-project memory source using inspectable Markdown files instead of opaque databases. It runs local embedding models for hybrid semantic search without requiring telemetry or external services.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver specific evidence packets to the agent for every query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs in real-time. It utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models via an MCP-native server to provide local-first RAG and vector search.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts to ensure agents only load necessary context, reducing prompt tokens by 94%. It provides local-first persistence and session history tracking through MCP-native stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This project provides reflective memory for agents using a combination of BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, utilizing edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages identity, decisions, and workflows for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using plain Markdown files. It facilitates a source-neutral migration workflow for documents and chats across supported agent platforms.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with built-in 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch through importance-weighted recall and BM25 keyword search.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin implements a pull-model that supports real, immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It includes an on-demand summarizer and generates a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle payments across 29 chains, including EVM and Solana, using USDC and other stablecoins. It allows agents to pay for services or charge for their own APIs with 0% transaction fees settled directly to wallets.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing to connect agents with scripts, MCP servers, and specific skills. It features tools for neighbor traversal and knowledge retrieval, automatically generating tool routing notes via model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and targeted searching. It enhances retrieval accuracy through configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin enables private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for searching, syncing, and reading files.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, offering metadata filters and MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This suite provides 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve agent state.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies data rot and contradictions within agent memory using a git-backed directory for versioned markdown storage. It utilizes specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators to propose evidence-cited diffs for manual review, offering five slash commands for capturing and recalling information without a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to enable autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system generates prototypes, decks, and documents using real CSS and components on macOS and Windows. It provides coding-agent CLI support for Hermes Agent and integrates with DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance security-focused agent capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts natural language, Mermaid, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments during updates. It also enforces architecture contracts through YAML/JSON rules and Diagram-as-Test functionality.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides a master router and connector for delegated permissions and dispute resolution. It includes vendored protocol skills to facilitate secure transactions and verification.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It supports rewrite and detect-only modes and is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenClaw agents.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library that integrates with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting skills and monitoring session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library offers 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation directory.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. Distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license, it provides ready-to-paste exports for various assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent and other platforms to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and supports multiple environments including OpenClaw and Cursor.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects reusable patterns in active workflows to propose new skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts and tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These skills transform rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. The workflow features Lite and Full modes for varying complexity and a review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill weaves prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that uses SQLite and Git for local-first session storage. It implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and utilizes Markdown-based recipes for prompt-first working methods.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on captured work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These interoperable skills follow the Agent Skills specification to enable interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. They support CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, along with specialized services for CRE and ACE.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides installation guides and agent skills formatted in SKILL.md specifically for Portuguese speakers. It adheres to the agentskills.io standard to ensure compatibility with the broader ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models via the BFL API. The package includes a router to direct requests to specialized agents and supports polling, webhooks, and error handling.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates agentskills.io-compliant skills from code, documentation, and developer discourse. It manages the skill lifecycle by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits for version control.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution via a Python client or CLI. It also integrates commerce features using TON payments for skill transactions.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures reliability through built-in rollback procedures and recovery checkpoints for long-running operations.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that operates through a Rust-based CLI using four verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It supports model processing via OpenAI API and Codex access on macOS and Linux.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided script for validating Nextcloud App Password credentials.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. The system is designed for efficiency and includes graceful degradation if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub serves as a community hub for one-click skill installation and autonomous resource discovery following the ARD v0.9 specification. It operates 24/7 on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only security skill employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial code reviews and identify edge cases. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a personal execution system that uses an MCP connection for agent-driven scheduling of habits and study blocks. It stores data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces via a React web app and an Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes Hermes Agent prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram, reducing token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a trio of agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in languages such as Python, Go, and Rust. It implements a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python-based goal engine to maintain persistent task states and prevent early-stop issues during debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to address CVE-driven scenarios.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills add session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations. The toolkit also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes utilities for detecting state drift.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible README demonstrations by generating recording scripts with vhs or Playwright. It manages the full lifecycle of rendering and compression, ensuring GIF files remain under 8 MB for optimized embedding.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical debt through a validator that detects spec drift. It monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to ensure skills remain compatible with current runtime profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework enables agents to self-improve by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It secures the update process by gating all proposed changes behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability across 11 monitoring tabs, covering metrics such as token costs, session health, and error tracking. It operates with a strict read-only boundary and zero outbound telemetry, though it offers an optional script for external incident alerts.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It facilitates immediate integration by providing direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and interpreter selection for agents operating across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures cross-platform compatibility by verifying existing project-specific Python runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill enables agents to automate payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across multiple protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent environment.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This utility certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill actually works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows agents to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes a complete toolkit for listing bounties, purchasing context, and managing decentralized bounty boards.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 distinct tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and produces structured briefings containing core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection of skills provides specialized Chinese-language utilities, including Douyin video-to-markdown transcription and document OCR. It also features a tool designed to remove AI-style writing patterns from generated text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary software binaries, offering a reliable way to manage development tool dependencies.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. It includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile operation.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile environments.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It secures agent operations using AES-256-GCM encryption and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows users to build specific Hermes tags and ensures persistent state through mounted home directories.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment uses systemd to run Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics by coordinating specialized LLM agents across providers like OpenAI and Anthropic. It maintains a decision-log memory and incorporates automated risk management evaluation to govern financial trading workflows.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control provides a self-hosted orchestration layer for dispatching tasks and monitoring agent spend through Web UI, CLI, or REST API interfaces. It manages agent registration and memory browsing, supporting local installation via Node.js or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, using tmux integration for persistent sessions. It ensures secure execution through sandboxing with Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers across TUI and web dashboards.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template functions as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting Claude-style MCP protocols in stdio mode. It features HTTP signal detection to manage payment-required states for paid APIs during agent orchestration.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this project scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams via a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and support for over 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to manage agent team delegation and integrates MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control platform uses a Kanban board to track autonomous task status and human-in-the-loop verification for task completions. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution to facilitate real-time supervision of Hermes agents.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure using a strict pipeline architecture. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via Hermes Kanban.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an agent-vs-agent arena where two autonomous AI companies, powered by Paperclip and Hermes Agent, compete for GitHub stars. A real-time dashboard visualizes the scoreboard metrics, code, and tasks of the nine competing agents.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080 to perform parallel model querying and synthesis.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that synchronizes automatically as files change. It integrates with Hermes Agent via an MCP server to reduce token usage and tool calls through pre-indexed codebase context.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI utility that tracks token consumption across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a Terminal User Interface for visualization and allows users to submit usage data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from coding agents like Hermes Agent and Cursor. It redacts authentication headers during recording and generates self-contained HTML viewers for analyzing exported sessions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token costs and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and 35+ other AI tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed usage breakdowns by model, project, and session.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications using Hermes Agent. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows to support autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A customization tool for the Hermes terminal UI that allows users to apply community-created themes and ASCII art banners. It uses YAML-based configurations to modify visual elements like spinners and banner colors.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to run natively within the Claude Code Channel without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It enables agents to conduct commerce using USDC and SOL payments on the Solana blockchain.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides memory adapters for platforms like Slack and VS Code to support frameworks such as LangGraph and the Claude Agent SDK. It utilizes a two-tier system consisting of knowledge graphs and session caches.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup uses RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research and DevOps, featuring automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This automated installer deploys a complete hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that includes support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter for AI agent configurations that flags overlapping tool descriptions and missing termination conditions using HERM v1.1 scoring. It performs deterministic local checks and supports CI integration via SARIF exports and baseline workflows.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills from OpenClaw to the Hermes environment. it maps existing configurations into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It monitors performance drift using config-aware baselines and offers both passive analysis and scheduled active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed as a local-first skill for generating revenue, this tool manages external actions through explicit approval contracts. It processes bounded JSON via stdin and emits JSON responses to handle opportunities, offer previews, and entitlements.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant provides a fully local, offline interface for Hermes Agent with wake-word support and adaptive turn-taking. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro without requiring API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It includes a dedicated circuit breaker for API outages and provides specific tools for adding, deleting, and searching memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations across various AI agents and CLI tools, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It supports remote access via WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram, while providing 21 professional assistants for document and presentation tasks.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed using Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the deployment of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a graphical user interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard manages multi-platform AI chat and scheduled jobs across runtimes like Hermes and Ekko. It includes a visual workflow canvas with approval gates and allows users to configure unified channels for ten platforms, including Discord and Slack.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a full file browser with Monaco, a PTY terminal, and specialized managers for memory, skills, and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents, including Hermes and Claude Code, into a single collaborative workspace. It supports deployment via desktop, Docker, or native mobile clients and allows for the registration of any ACP-compatible agent.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It features an embedded terminal for shell access and native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a core kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports memory management and LaTeX/Markdown rendering for Hermes Agent users.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium extension integrates the Hermes Agent runtime directly into browser side panels for Chrome and Edge. It offers AI-assisted tab scoping for context management and site-aware drafting across 31 writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that connects directly to self-hosted hermes-webui servers without third-party relays. It enables mobile users to manage tasks, browse workspace files, and engage in real-time chat.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and OpenClaw, alongside custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token latency and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive terminal user interface (TUI) functions as a consciousness monitor with nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard features a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health via kanban pipelines. It includes an MCP server control plane for managing lifecycles and visualizes real-time chat streaming and tool calls.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit that attributes live quota burn for Codex and Claude to individual sessions. It offers searchable transcripts and image browsing for over 14 agent formats while operating locally with no telemetry or history uploads.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent management.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically includes an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports profile and skill management alongside a kanban board designed for agentic work and task tracking.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for local models, TTS, and ComfyUI, supporting both LM Studio and OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes an integrated file browser and dedicated management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time tracking for session activity and costs while allowing full inspection of skill source code. It offers read-only access to conversation histories, configuration settings, and environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, supported by isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a project manager orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
